arxiv-1908-07093.title: Uniform Reliability of Self-Join-Free Conjunctive Queries
arxiv-1908-07093.creator: Antoine Amarilli ORCID:0000-0002-7977-4441 \rsuper a, Benny Kimelfeld ORCID:0000-0002-7156-1572 \rsuper b
arxiv-1908-07093.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Antoine Amarilli ORCID:0000-0002-7977-4441 \rsuper a, Benny Kimelfeld ORCID:0000-0002-7156-1572 \rsuper b. The reliability of a Boolean Conjunctive Query (CQ) over a tuple-independent probabilistic database is the probability that the CQ is satisfied when the tuples of the database are sampled one by one, independently, with their associated probability. For queries without self-joins (repeated relation symbols), the data complexity of this problem is fully characterized by a known dichotomy: reliability can be computed in polynomial time for hierarchical queries, and is #P-hard for non-hierarchical queries.

arxiv-2102-10296.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Seyedali Meghdadi 1 3 , Guido Tack 1 , Ariel Liebman 1 , Nicolas Langrené 2. arxiv-2108-05803.title: Averaged circuit eigenvalue sampling
arxiv-2108-05803.creator: Steven T. Flammia
arxiv-2108-05803.description: Abstract We introduce ACES, a method for scalable noise metrology of quantum circuits that stands for Averaged Circuit Eigenvalue Sampling. It simultaneously estimates the individual error rates of all the gates in collections of quantum circuits, and can even account for space and time correlations between these gates.

arxiv-2203-15132.description: Abstract We propose a novel architecture for depth estimation from a single image. The architecture itself is based on the popular encoder-decoder architecture that is frequently used as a starting point for all dense regression tasks. We build on AdaBins which estimates a global distribution of depth values for the input image and evolve the architecture in two ways.

arxiv-2306-03962.creator: Francesco Pinto ∗, Yaxi Hu ∗, Fanny Yang, Amartya Sanyal
arxiv-2306-03962.description: Abstract In Semi-Supervised Semi-Private (SP) learning, the learner has access to both public unlabelled and private labelled data. We propose a computationally efficient algorithm that, under mild assumptions on the data, provably achieves significantly lower private labelled sample complexity and can be efficiently run on real-world datasets.

arxiv-2407-21072.creator: Marco AF Pimentel, Clément Christophe, Tathagata Raha, Prateek Munjal
arxiv-2407-21072.description: Abstract As large language models (LLMs) continue to evolve, the need for robust and standardized evaluation benchmarks becomes paramount. Evaluating the performance of these models is a complex challenge that requires careful consideration of various linguistic tasks, model architectures, and benchmarking methodologies.

arxiv-2412-01573.title: Single-Photon Generation: Materials, Techniques, and the Rydberg Exciton Frontier
arxiv-2412-01573.creator: Arya Keni 1, † \dagger, Kinjol Barua 1, † \dagger, Khabat Heshami 2,3,4,*, Alisa Javadi 5,6,*, and Hadiseh Alaeian 1,7,*
arxiv-2412-01573.description: Abstract Due to their quantum nature, single-photon emitters generate individual photons in bursts or streams. They are paramount in emerging quantum technologies such as quantum key distribution, quantum repeaters, and measurement-based quantum computing. Many such systems have been reported in the last three decades, from Rubidium atoms coupled to cavities to semiconductor quantum dots and color centers implanted in waveguides.

arxiv-2507-15311.creator: Hao Wang (王灏), Hao Zhou, Yi-Zhong Fan, Da-Ming Wei
arxiv-2507-15311.description: Abstract Gamma-ray bursts are expected to be generated by structured jets, whose profiles significantly impact their afterglow emission. Previously, we developed a numerical code jetsimpy , to model the afterglow of jets with arbitrary angular profiles. In this study, we extend the code to incorporate a stratified radial profile, enabling it to model jets with arbitrary axisymmetric two-dimensional structures.

pmc-12692752.description: Technetium-99m bone scintigraphy has revolutionized the non-invasive diagnosis of transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CM) and markedly increased disease recognition. pmc-12715062.title: Prospective comparative study of scaphocapitate arthrodesis with and without lunate excision for stage IIIB Kienböck’s disease
pmc-12715062.creator: Galal Hegazy, Mahmoud Seddik, Rashed El-Sadek, Mohamed Gamal, Elsayed Shaheen, Mohammed Alnahas, Ibrahem El-Sebaey, Abdulhamid Elzoghby, Ahmed Darweash
pmc-12715062.description: IntroductionKienböck’s disease is a progressive avascular necrosis of the lunate that causes wrist pain and functional impairment. Surgical intervention is often needed for advanced stage IIIB disease to relieve symptoms and preserve the carpal structure. Scaphocapitate (SC) arthrodesis is an established technique, but the value of lunate excision versus preservation remains debated.

pmc-13214243.title: Resurgence of measles in Bangladesh amid a global upsurge: an urgent call for emergency public health response
pmc-13214243.creator: Sadeed Hossain, Ahsan Ahmed, Mohammad Sorowar Hossain
pmc-13214243.description: Measles, a highly contagious yet vaccine-preventable disease, is resurging in Bangladesh following a global rise in cases. This study highlights recent epidemiological trends, including widespread transmission across most districts, rising pediatric vulnerability and increased mortality. Many affected children are either too young to be vaccinated or have missed their doses.
